mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM send_real_recipient_whitelist w JOIN send_real_whitelist_consent c ON w.id = c.whitelist_id WHERE c.channel_id = #{channelId} AND w.is_active = 1 AND c.is_consented = 1 AND NVL(w.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND ( (#{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND w.phone = #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (#{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND w.email = #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) )
